artworks.title: Armes symboliques de la ville de Paris (Symbolical Arms of the City of Paris)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a coat of arms featuring a sailing ship, with the ship in full sail navigating calm waters. There are fleur-de-lis symbols in the background, and a stylized crown or battlement on top. Two stylized olive or laurel branches surround the central shield, tied together at the base. The drawing is intricately detailed with fine lines.

artworks.title: Le stryge (The Vampire)
artworks.description: The image shows a stone gargoyle on the edge of a building overlooking a cityscape. A tall Gothic tower is prominent on the horizon line, surrounded by various buildings. The artwork features detailed brushstrokes and engravings, emphasizing texture. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of sepia. Birds are seen flying in the background sky.

artworks.title: Le Petit Pont, Paris
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed historic cityscape. A stone embankment crosses the lower part of the image near a waterway. People are engaged in activities along the water and in boats. A stone bridge with buildings on top is visible in the background, leading to a grand Gothic cathedral with twin towers. The architectural details are depicted in an etching style with fine lines. The color palette is mainly sepia, creating a timeless feel. The sky has soft clouds, serving as a serene backdrop to the urban scene.

artworks.title: L'arche du Pont Notre-Dame, Paris (An Arch of the Notre-Dame Bridge, Paris)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid green paper
artworks.description: An arched stone bridge is depicted from below in an etching. The scene shows a riverside with buildings, a bridge, and figures on boats. Intricate lines create depth and texture. Dark shadows are seen under the bridge, contrasting with the river and boats. Buildings, sky, clouds, and birds are depicted in lighter tones. The color palette consists of sepia tones typical of etchings.

artworks.title: La galerie Notre-Dame, Paris (The Gallery of Notre Dame, Paris)
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural view from within a cloister or colonnade, looking outward. The point of view appears elevated, showing rooftops and buildings beyond. The horizon is low, hidden by columns with ornate arches. Birds are in flight nearby. The scene includes gothic architecture and a town with additional buildings and a distant spire. The image is done in an etching style with a monochromatic sepia color palette, emphasizing light and shadow.

artworks.title: La Tour de l'Horloge, Paris (The Clock Tower, Paris)
artworks.description: The image depicts an architectural scene with a grand building featuring towers and steep rooftops. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, highlighting the structures. Additional architectural elements are visible in the background against a cloudy sky with smoke. The artwork is created using an etching technique with fine lines detailing the building's shadows and textures. The monochrome color palette uses sepia tones, typical of etched prints. In the foreground, a bridge with rounded arches spans a body of water, with a boat passing underneath.

artworks.title: La Tour de l'Horloge, Paris (The Clock Tower, Paris)
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural view of a historical building with a tower, pointed roof structures, and tall chimneys. The horizon is obstructed by the building, highlighting its details. The sky features hatching lines for clouds and smoke. The artwork's precise line work defines architectural features with diagonals and vertical lines, creating depth. The sepia color palette enhances a classic feel. A bridge with arched passages and a partially visible cart are in the foreground. Other distant buildings show windows and structural elements like the central building.

artworks.title: Saint-Etienne-du-Mont, Paris (Church of St. Stephen of the Mount, Paris)
artworks.description: The image shows a street view of a European city with a tall tower featuring a domed top in the center distance. The horizon is obscured by buildings, and the tower draws the eye upward towards the sky. The scene is depicted using etching techniques, with detailed linear strokes composing the buildings and sky. The color palette is monochrome, with variations of sepia and tan. People are seen on the cobbled street, flanked by structures that lead to the church further down. Architectural details, such as arched windows and carvings, are finely etched, showcasing the grandeur of the structures and creating a sense of depth and perspective.

artworks.title: La Pompe Notre-Dame, Paris (The Notre-Dame Pump)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on green laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays an architectural scene with structures rising prominently above, viewed from a low angle. The horizon is hidden by the buildings, with a large detailed structure on stilts dominating the scene. The buildings are adorned with windows and chimneys. The brushstrokes imitate fine etching, depicting textures of the structures and clouds. The color palette is monochromatic in sepia tones, giving a vintage feel. Small boats with occupants are seen in the water closest to us, adding activity to the densely constructed riverbanks. In the distance, the buildings become less detailed, enhancing the complexity of the urban setting.

artworks.title: La Pompe Notre-Dame, Paris (The Notre-Dame Pump)
artworks.description: This image showcases an architectural structure on a wooden scaffolding extending into the water. There is an elevated structure with a tall, narrow tower to the left, supported by wooden beams. A bridge leads to a row of buildings in the distance, detailed with multiple stories and sloped roofs. The horizon line is high, with buildings and cathedral towers visible against the sky. The sky is detailed with cloud linework. Birds are faintly visible in the sky. Boats and figures are shown in the river. The artwork is monochromatic, using detailed lines and crosshatching to convey depth and texture, emphasizing architectural features and creating contrast between the sky and structures.

artworks.title: Le Pont Neuf, Paris
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on green laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a low point of view of a stone bridge spanning across a waterway. The bridge arches overhead, supported by large columns. Smoke trails can be seen above the bridge, with detailed buildings in the distance. The etching shows fine lines and cross-hatching for texture and depth, creating a realistic appearance. The color palette is dominated by sepia tones. Rowboats and wooden structures are close by, while the midsection features the massive arches of the bridge. Urban buildings and shadows can be seen in the distance.

artworks.title: Le Pont-au-Change, Paris
artworks.description: The image shows a water level perspective with a stone bridge on the left and a grand building on the right. The horizon is low with the bridge dominating the foreground. The building has multiple pointed towers and detailed architectural elements. The brushstrokes resemble detailed line etchings and depict architectural details and water textures. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of sepia. In the foreground, small boats with figures can be seen. Various architectural features of the building are visible in the distance. The composition combines water activity with stone structures.

artworks.title: L'abside de Notre-Dame de Paris (The Apse of the Cathedral of Notre-Dame, Paris)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a view from the bank of a river, looking toward Notre Dame Cathedral. Two towers of Notre Dame stand out, dominating the scene. The horizon is near the middle of the image, lined with buildings. The etching shows detailed buildings, natural elements, and clouds in the sky. Closest to us, figures are seen on a sandy riverbank next to a horse-drawn cart, with boats in the water nearby. The color palette is monochromatic in brown and black.

artworks.title: La morgue, Paris (The Mortuary)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an urban scene from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon line is not distinctly visible as the view is framed by densely packed buildings. Smoke rises from a couple of chimneys. The style appears to be an etching, with fine lines capturing architectural textures. The color palette is mostly monochrome. Closest to us, a boat is docked, partially covered by shading or shadows, with people depicted mid-movement on the quay. Beyond, a line of buildings creates a layered effect.

artworks.title: Le tombeau de Molière, au Père-Lachaise, Paris (Moliere's Tomb, in Père-Lachaise Cemetary, Paris)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a monument dedicated to Molière. The drawing depicts a rectangular structure resembling a tomb or altar with the name "Molière" inscribed on it. Atop the structure is an urn with flames emanating from it, creating radiating lines of light. Flanking the monument are decorative sprigs or branches with leaves. The line work is meticulous, with shading used to give depth to the monument and to emphasize the flame's glow. The drawing includes inscriptions at the bottom corners.

artworks.title: Tourelle, Rue de l'École de Médecine, 22, Paris (House with a Turret, No. 22, Street of the School of Medecine, Paris)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a street scene with intricate buildings lining a narrow passage. Figures are seen on the street, along with a horse-drawn cart. Surreal figures float in the sky above, contrasting with the detailed architectural elements. The monochromatic color palette adds depth to the composition.

artworks.title: La Rue des Chantres, Paris (Chantrey Street, Paris)
artworks.description: The detailed etching depicts a narrow urban street with tall buildings on both sides. In the distance is a cathedral spire. The sky shows clouds and birds. The etching features cross-hatched lines for texture, sharp strokes for architectural details, and a monochromatic color palette. People are seen interacting on the street.

artworks.title: Bain-froid chevrier, dit "de l'École" (Chevrier's Cold-Bath Establishment, Sometimes called the "School-Baths")
artworks.description: The image shows a view from an elevated position, looking down at a canal or waterway with stone walls on one side and buildings on the other. The horizon is in the upper third of the composition, with buildings on an embankment. The artwork is composed of intricate cross-hatching creating texture on the buildings and clouds. The color scheme is sepia, emphasizing the detailed lines. A wooden platform crosses the water where people and boats are visible. In the background, there are more buildings and signs, including one for a bathing establishment. The skyline merges with the cloudy sky, with faint bird silhouettes.

artworks.title: Bain-froid chevrier, dit "de l'École" (Chevrier's Cold-Bath Establishment, Sometimes called the "School-Baths")
artworks.description: The image shows a scene from a slightly elevated viewpoint. In the foreground, there are wooden docks and small boats on the water with people. A large stone wall is on the left, leading into the distance. In the background, buildings and statues are visible on the horizon. The artwork is made using fine-lined brushstrokes typical of etching, with a monochromatic sepia color palette. Fluffy clouds fill the sky above the scene.

artworks.title: Bain-froid chevrier, dit "de l'École" (Chevrier's Cold-Bath Establishment, Sometimes called the "School-Baths")
artworks.medium: etching in black and gold on Hudelist laid paper
artworks.description: The horizon line is positioned slightly above the middle of the image. Stone buildings line a waterway, leading to a section with small structures, with a sign reading "BAIN-FROID CHEVRIER." Intricate architectural details are visible on the buildings to the right, including columns and a flag. On the left, there is a massive stone facade with linear hatch marks. The sky is filled with soft clouds. The color palette is monochrome, predominantly brown. Neat rows of trees and more buildings are seen in the distance.

artworks.title: Bain-froid chevrier, dit "de l'École" (Chevrier's Cold-Bath Establishment, Sometimes called the "School-Baths")
artworks.description: This image shows an architectural scene along a canal or river. A wooden bridge crosses the water, supported by a stone structure on the left. The horizon features elevated buildings, possibly from an older European cityscape. The brushstroke technique is detailed, resembling an etching. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones. A round building with balconies and a flagpole is on the right. In the distance, hills covered with trees create a backdrop.

artworks.title: La Loi lunaire, 1er planche ("Lunar" Law, 1st plate)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a document enclosed in a decorative border. The central focus is a handwritten text enclosed within an ornamental frame, featuring towers at each side which culminate in stylized flaming torches. At the top, there are cloud-like designs with two diagonal lines converging towards the center. At the bottom, the words "Loi Sunaire" are written above a decorative element featuring a burning flame atop a small platform with three legs, surrounded by rays. The border includes decorative details such as stars and a bird-like figure at the base. The style is characterized by intricate line work and symbolic imagery.

artworks.title: L.J.-Marie Bizeul, a Breton Archaeologist
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed drawing of a man's side profile from the chest up. The man has a prominent nose, high cheekbones, and a slightly furrowed brow. His hair is short and slightly tousled with a textured, wavy quality. He is wearing a high-collared coat with rich details and a shirt with a cravat. The man's expression is neutral, with his head turned to the left and eyes focused forward. The background is plain, with inscriptions above and below the portrait indicating his name, Bizeul, and the year 1860.

artworks.title: Jean Besly
artworks.medium: etching on D&C Blauw laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a seated man from the waist up. He has pronounced facial features, including defined cheekbones, a long, narrow nose, short dark hair combed back, a trimmed beard, and wears a dark formal garment with a narrow pleated collar fastened with buttons and a bow around his waist. In the background, there is a shield-like emblem with symbols near his head. The text on the image identifies him as "Iean Besly" and includes the date "1861" at the bottom.
